acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode.
alkylation reagent: The database searches were run with propionamide (C) and oxidation (M) as variable modifications
cleavage agent: Protein spots dissected from preparative gels were subjected to in-gel digestion with trypsin
fractionation method: Tumorous tissue and adjacent non-tumorous liver tissue from eight CCC patients were analyzed by means of two-dimensional differential in-gel electrophoresis
fragmentation method: tandem mass spectra of the 20 most abundant peaks were measured in the linear ion trap after peptide fragmentation by collision-induced dissociation.
instrument: online coupled to an LTQ Orbitrap Elite (Thermo Scientific). ... MALDI-TOF-MS analyses were performed on an UltraFlexTM II instrument
labeling: analyzed by means of two-dimensional differential in-gel electrophoresis and mass-spectrometry-based label-free proteomics.
